text: As a senior at this university who spends considerable time reading in the library, I am writing to offer constructive suggestions on improving its current facilities and services.
First and foremost, it would be deeply appreciated if the library could extend its opening hours during exam weeks, which would greatly facilitate students' revision.
Equally important is that more power outlets and silent study cubicles are expected to be added, as a quiet environment enables readers to concentrate effectively.
Simple as these adjustments may seem, not only can they enhance daily study efficiency, but they also reflect greater care for student needs.
I would be honored if you could take my suggestions into favorable consideration.
Looking forward to your earliest reply.
